meta.name: muapi-ugc-lifestyle-try-on
meta.description: Generate UGC-style (User Generated Content) lifestyle photos of a person wearing or using your product — authentic, relatable, social-media-native imagery.

copy.tagline: 生成真人感的产品穿搭生活照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让产品照片看起来像真实用户分享
copy.tagline_en: Generate authentic lifestyle photos of people using your product
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want product photos that look like real user posts

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的产品图片和描述，生成模特穿着或使用该产品的 UGC 风格生活照，并进一步优化成更自然的社交平台内容。
howto.when: 当你提到“UGC”、“试穿”、“生活照”等关键词，或要求生成产品穿搭/使用场景照片时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张白色卫衣的 UGC 生活照。
say.note: 会使用默认模特和场景生成试穿照。

say.text: 用这张包的照片，生成一个咖啡店场景的穿搭图。
say.note: 需上传产品图片，指定场景。

say.text: 把刚才的试穿照做成 TikTok 风格的视频。
say.note: 会建议用 kling-v3.0 生成视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate UGC-style lifestyle photos of a model wearing or using your product based on your product image and description, then refine it into more natural social-media-ready content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "UGC", "try on", "lifestyle photo", or ask to generate product outfit/scene photos.

say_en.text: Generate a UGC lifestyle photo of a white hoodie.
Use this bag photo to create an outfit shot in a coffee shop.
Turn the try-on photo into a TikTok-style video.
